'''Whisper Base''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] military base on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] established by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Lasre Dardano]].

It was built to spy on a political rival of Dardano's; one Admiral [[Corlen]], who was in charge of the garrison in [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]]. To this end it had a powerful signal intelligence array which allowed it to monitor Imperial activity in the system. This, along with the Imperial codes that the base carries, made it a prime target for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], who sent a team of infiltrators to [[Takeover at Whisper Base|capture]] the listening post.
